name: Layers test
author: Edgemodders
description: A sample of O10: a page over the whole game view ("fill": "screen") with a faint tint that takes the mouse, as an editing viewport does. Its window moves inside the page, the tint staying put. REDnode's tool windows (the launcher tab, Mod log, Mod Manager, and the Test timer once allowed) stay above it. Solo hides every other package's window; asks for the solo permission.
